description.paragraph1: RISE Foundation (Social Ecological Indonesia) is a non-profit organization focused on the integration of social empowerment and environmental ecosystem preservation in Indonesia. We believe that human welfare cannot be separated from the health of the surrounding nature.
description.paragraph2: Founded with a spirit of collaboration, we run various programs ranging from environmental education, creative economy development based on sustainable natural resources, to ecological policy advocacy. Through a holistic approach, RISE is committed to being a bridge for the creation of harmony between social progress and the sustainability of the earth.
description.paragraph3: Our main focuses include critical land restoration, community waste management, and assisting indigenous communities in preserving local wisdom that supports nature conservation.

visi.title: Vision
visi.description: To realize a just, sustainable, and knowledge-based future for Indonesia through harmony between social empowerment of the community and ecosystem preservation.

misi.title: Mission
items: To produce applicative research and knowledge in the fields of social, environmental, and sustainable policy.
To empower communities through a participatory approach in food, energy, waste, and the green economy.
To facilitate the resolution of socio-ecological conflicts in a dialogical and just manner.
To enhance environmental literacy and public awareness towards a low-carbon lifestyle.
To provide open socio-ecological data to support transparency and evidence-based policy.
